Full CRUD REST API

Zod validation, consistent response/error conventions, full CRUD with nested comment routes, filtering/sorting/pagination, and unit tests that grow alongside the code.

  • Consistent Response & Error Conventions

    A fixed envelope every response uses, a custom error class, and cleaning up the messages Prisma's own errors leak.

  • Validating Requests with Zod

    Replacing hand-rolled `if` checks with schema validation — what it buys you, and how it plugs into Express as middleware.

  • Full CRUD & Nested Routes

    PATCH, DELETE, and a whole second resource nested under Ticket — Comment, reached only through its parent.

  • Filtering, Sorting & Pagination

    Turning a validated query string into the where/orderBy/skip/take options a real ticket list needs.

  • Testing Validators & Middleware

    The Week 3 habit: a unit test suite that grows alongside services/validators, not bolted on at the end.

  • Validating Configuration with Zod

    One more thing this lesson's Zod schemas turn out to be good for: process.env, not just req.
